measurements.caption: A night-time view from a stationary camera shows a wet urban intersection with streetlights and car headlights reflecting off the rain-slicked road; at 00:00, a bright flash of lightning illuminates the distant horizon followed immediately by a sharp crackle and deep rumble of thunder, and heavy rain begins to fall steadily, intensifying the glistening reflections of the city lights on the wet pavement as the storm progresses with subsequent flashes of lightning and additional thunderclaps until the sky lightens slightly toward the end of the clip.

measurements.caption: A static nighttime view of a rain-soaked street intersection shows wet pavement reflecting the glow of streetlights, traffic signals, and vehicle headlights. At approximately one second into the clip, a bright vertical lightning flash illuminates the distant sky above the horizon, immediately followed by a loud thunderclap. The storm intensifies as heavy rain falls, creating strong reflections of the streetlights and vehicle lights on the wet road surface. Multiple subsequent thunderclaps occur at regular intervals, each corresponding with the visible progression of the storm. Around fifteen seconds in, the sky begins to lighten slightly, indicating the storm is moving away, while rain continues to fall at a reduced rate, maintaining the reflective sheen on the road until the end of the clip.

measurements.caption: A dark urban street scene at night shows cars moving through an intersection under dim streetlights and building illumination; at 00:03, a bright lightning flash briefly reveals the sky and landscape followed immediately by a deep thunderclap, then rain begins to fall, creating wet reflective surfaces on the road and parking lots while traffic continues moving through the storm, with the sky gradually lightening to a pale blue hue by 00:15 suggesting dawn or early morning as the rain persists throughout the scene, captured from a fixed high-angle static camera with no speech present and the storm’s precise distance uncertain due to limited visual detail.
